title: Quantum-Inspired Optimization Process for Data Imputation
abstract: arXiv:2505.04841v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data imputation is a critical preprocessing step, particularly in clinical datasets where missingness can bias downstream inference. We propose a quantum-inspired imputation framework and evaluate it on the UCI Pima Indians Diabetes dataset, where several physiological variables contain structural zeros that are treated as missing. The approach combines Principal Component Analysis (PCA) with quantum rotation-based reconstruction, where rotation angles are selected via gradient-free optimizers (Simulated Annealing, COBYLA, and Differential Evolution). For robustness, we retain the top three optimizer solutions per method and reconstruct missing values under distribution-aware bounds (e.g., $\pm 2$ standard deviations) and avoid unrealistic collapse toward central tendency. We also benchmark against (i) classical baselines (Mean, KNN, MICE, Decision Tree), (ii) modern matrix/ML imputers (SoftImpute, MissForest, VAE), and (iii) r

translated_title: 量子启发的数据填补优化过程
translated_abstract: 数据填补是一个关键的预处理步骤，尤其是在临床数据集中，数据的缺失可能会使下游推断产生偏差。我们提出了一种量子启发的填补框架，并在UCI皮马印第安人糖尿病数据集上进行了评估，该数据集中多个生理变量包含被视为缺失的结构性零值。该方法将主成分分析（PCA）与基于量子旋转的重构相结合，其中旋转角度通过无梯度优化器（模拟退火、COBYLA和差分进化）进行选择。为了确保稳健性，我们为每种方法保留排名前三的优化器解，并在分布感知的边界（例如±2个标准差）内重构缺失值，从而避免不切实际地向中心趋势塌缩。我们还将该方法与(i)经典基线方法（均值、KNN、MICE、决策树）、(ii)现代矩阵/机器学习填补方法（SoftImpute、MissForest、VAE）以及(iii) r
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将PCA与量子旋转重构相结合、由无梯度优化器选择旋转角度的量子启发数据填补框架，在UCI糖尿病数据集上通过分布感知边界约束缺失值重构，并与经典及现代填补方法进行了基准比较。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a quantum-inspired data imputation framework that combines PCA with quantum rotation-based reconstruction using gradient-free optimizers, evaluates it on the UCI Pima Indians Diabetes dataset with distribution-aware bounds, and benchmarks it against classical and modern imputation methods.
